sloka: न सौभाग्ये न दाक्षिण्ये न ज्ञाने बुद्धि निश्चये ।न उत्तरे प्रति वक्तव्ये समो लोके तव अनघ ॥१-२२-१५॥
transliteration: na saubhāgye na dākṣiṇye na jñāne buddhi niścaye ।na uttare prati vaktavye samo loke tava anagha ॥1-22-15॥

translations.english: O sinless one, there is none in this world equal to you in good fortune, kindness, wisdom, in taking a decsion or giving a reply.
